purpose: Test whether stale self-conditioning within motif refinement contributes to motif-scaffold clashes and boundary gaps. This is a sampler ablation, not an established bug fix or a new step-count grid.
baseline: Original50-step unconditional flow,AE3,RePaint3,isolated-fragment codes and frame from isolated_motif_49864561. Existing recipe updates its denoised self-conditioning estimate once per outer Euler step, retaining it through the two inner refinements.
intervention: After each inner model evaluation, set the next self-conditioning estimate to x+(1-t)*v, using that evaluation's current clamped input x and velocity v before the Euler update. Everything else unchanged: weights,times,noise streams,motif codes,number of refinements and velocity evaluations. Default sampler behavior remains unchanged; no effect when repaint=1.
panel: Same16development families,four paired seeds,all64outputs retained. Cached isolated fragment encodings supplied without full scaffold coordinates. Reproduce old isolated outputs on the four fixed control families/allfour seeds before candidate comparison;latent maxabs<=1e-5,CA RMS<=.2A,CA-lDDT>=.99,and identical geometry. Frozen original checkpoint and decoder hashes. No training or locked tests.
primary: Joint motif dRMS<=1A and unchanged full-backbone coarse validity. Paired family bootstrap10,000draws. Refolding follow-up requires lower95percent bound of candidate-minus-baseline joint success>0, candidate motif<=1A fraction>=.98,and mean motif dRMS increase<=.1A. Preserve failures; no threshold or refinement-count tuning after outcomes.
followup: If the raw primary gate passes, assay all8fixed-profile candidate samples against all8paired baseline samples with4experimental positive controls. Fix only supplied motif residues in ProteinMPNN. Strict success requires raw motif/geometry plus one SAME refold withscTM>.5,motif dRMS<=1A and valid geometry. Full fixed budgets retained; do not select individual favorable cases.
resources: OneRTX10minutes,480secondworker cap,64GiBhost,excludeownECCnode. Original measured64samplegeneration~32seconds; controls/loading are additional. All own registered jobs only,eightGPUrunning+pending cap,finish by15UTC.
